schema:alternativeHeadline:
Reverse of a mailed postcard with a handwritten message, Brownsville postmark, green one-cent stamp and Wichita, Kansas recipient address.

Written text (transcribed as written):
Printed postcard: “THIS SPACE FOR WRITING MESSAGES. POST CARD THIS SPACE FOR ADDRESS ONLY. C. T. PHOTOCHROM R-29852 C. T. & CO. CHICAGO U.S. POSTAGE 1 CENT 1”
Postmark: “BROWNSVILLE, TEX. 4—P M JUN 20-16”
Handwritten message: “Brownsville Tex 6-20-16 Home Sweet home by the last of this week H.R.L.”
Handwritten address: “Mr. H. F. Leslie Wichita Kans. 721 Beacon”
